checks: Exact shipped __init__.py re-exports TensorSpec, serialize, serialize_file, deserialize and SafetensorError.

TensorSpec keyword constructor accepts dtype, shape, data_ptr and data_len. float32 input maps to the F32 dtype property; shape [2,2] and 16-byte contiguous owned ctypes storage match four explicitly little-endian float32 values.

The ctypes array remains strongly referenced by a local variable through both serialize and serialize_file, and bytes(buffer) is checked afterwards. This satisfies the original API's pointer lifetime requirement.
The deserialize result is the documented list of name/dictionary pairs containing dtype, shape and data; dict conversion and exact bytes comparisons use that original result shape.
The in-memory round trip checks exact tensor name, dtype, shape and bytes. File serialization independently reads and deserializes its output and verifies the same bytes.
The three pre-existing invalid inputs remain bounded and each must raise the original native SafetensorError. No exception is changed into a successful case.

The outer operations loop writes each completed operation receipt before continuing, records a failed operation separately and re-raises; successful HF work is retained without marking the entire Rust stage passed.
Native origin verification and exact Android/Python guard remain in place; no runtime package source, metadata, Cargo input, version or Requires-Python change is part of this API correction.
limitation: Static API and ownership review against the exact native-built wheel. The corrected full native Rust stage still requires a successful retry.
